extracted.intended_audience: state customers, contractors, IP managers and compliance officers involved in Russian Federation state-funded R&D (including Roscosmos, Ministry of Industry and Trade, Rospatent/FIPS)
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and mandatory requirements for legal protection, registration, inventory and commercial/legal handling of intellectual property created under Russian Federation state-funded R&D contracts, plus related audit and enforcement activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of developed documentation (know‑how vs scientific work)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition of the information contained in developed design and technological documentation as a know‑how (Ministry of Industry and Trade) or recognition of developed technical documentation as a scientific work (State Corporation “Roscosmos”).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choice of classification affects legal protection regime and follow‑on rights; audit identified inconsistent classification practices across bodies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check applications for state secret content
rubrics_metrics.description: Checking of applications for granting a patent for an invention or utility model created in the Russian Federation to determine whether there is information constituting a state secret (Ministry of Industry and Trade).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent filings for certain R&D must be screened for classified information before prosecution/registration; failure to do so was cited as a violation in audits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear designation of rightholder(s) in state contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid ambiguity in designation of rightholder(s) in respect of created results of intellectual activity in state R&D contracts (State Corporation “Roscosmos”).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contracts must explicitly name the owner(s) of resulting IP to prevent later disputes and ensure correct registration and use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of rights in name of Russian Federation or joint ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: When applicable, register the rights to results of intellectual activity in the name of the Russian Federation, jointly with the contractor, or in the name of a third person as specified by law and contract (Ministry of Industry and Trade, Roscosmos).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent and responsible bodies must follow established cases and procedures for allocation of ownership; improper registration was found in audits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct state inventory of R&D results
rubrics_metrics.description: Carry out the state inventory (and updating) of results of intellectual activity created under state contracts as required by law and decrees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inventory entries must be made into the Unified state information system; audits found large percentages of created results not entered (e.g., 65.5%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notify state customer of creation of protectable results
rubrics_metrics.description: Organization‑contractor must give notification to the state customer on creation of protectable results of intellectual activity under the state contract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to notify was repeatedly detected; notifications trigger state customer decisions on protection form and registration actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: State customer must decide and communicate form of legal protection and use
rubrics_metrics.description: State customer must send the decision on the form of legal protection of the received result and its use under the state contract to the contractor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State customer’s decision (e.g., patenting, trade secret, transfer) must be timely communicated; Roscosmos failed in some cases to send decisions to contractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contractor must provide patent research reports to state customer
rubrics_metrics.description: Contractors are required to conduct patent researches and provide reports specified under the state contract to the state customer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits found instances where patent research was not conducted or reports were missing; compliance with reporting requirements is mandatory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent researches must comply with GOST R 15.011–96
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports on patent researches must comply with the national standard GOST R 15.011–96.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits identified non‑compliant patent research reports as violations; adherence to the GOST standard is a formal requirement for the reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure legal protection (registration) of protectable results
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform actions to ensure legal protection of results of intellectual activity (register patents, utility models, designs, programs, databases, topographies, know‑how) in accordance with legislation and contract terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent noted many results were legally protectable but not registered; state customers/contractors must follow registration procedures to involve rights in economic turnover.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide information necessary for state inventory
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizations must provide the state customer with information necessary for the state inventory (including updates) of created results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to provide inventory information was frequently detected (e.g., missing entries for hundreds of results).

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduce and maintain trade secret regime where required
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduce a trade secret regime for created results of intellectual activity in accordance with the established procedure where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits found violations in introducing trade secret regimes; proper classification and documentation are required to claim trade secret protection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocate and document rights to prior IP used in R&D
rubrics_metrics.description: Agree with the state customer on the use and allocation of rights to prior intellectual property owned by the contractor or third parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to address prior IP in agreements leads to violations; contracts must include provisions for acquisition or license of third‑party rights if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure proper remuneration and payment to authors
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure payment of author’s remuneration and remuneration rights for creation of protected results of intellectual activity (including service results).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits detected violations concerning remuneration; contracts and practice must implement statutory author remuneration obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquire and secure exclusive rights to software and databases for transfer to the Russian Federation
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration of exclusive rights to created computer programs and databases must ensure acquisition of such rights from third persons if needed for transfer to the Russian Federation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Violations were detected where rights were not properly acquired from third parties, undermining transfer to RF ownership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclude license agreements properly for RF‑owned IP during implementation and international activities
rubrics_metrics.description: When rights are owned by the Russian Federation, conclusion of license agreements between organizations and state customers (including for military-technical cooperation and international economic activities) must comply with required procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits found violations in how license agreements were concluded and executed; special procedures apply for controlled production and international transfers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect provisions of existing license agreements on use of RF‑owned results
rubrics_metrics.description: Fulfill the provisions of concluded license agreements on the right to use results of intellectual activity owned by the Russian Federation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non‑fulfillment of license provisions was detected; compliance monitoring and enforcement actions are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocate rights with co‑contractors explicitly
rubrics_metrics.description: Agreements with co‑contractors must explicitly address allocation of rights to the results of intellectual activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ambiguities in co‑contractor rights allocation were a source of violations; contracts must be specific.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid misappropriation of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Prevent misappropriation (unauthorized claiming) of rights to results of intellectual activity created under state R&D contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits recorded misappropriation cases; proper documentation, registration and contractual clarity reduce risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notify state customer of early termination of legal protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Contractors must notify the state customer about early termination of legal protection (e.g., patent lapsing) for results created under the contract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits found failures to notify; notifications are needed for inventory accuracy and management of rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fulfill conditions for subsidies (performance indicators)
rubrics_metrics.description: Meet conditions tied to granting subsidies, including achieving performance indicators: creation of protectable results, legal protection and involvement of rights in economic/civil turnover to create innovative products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non‑fulfillment of subsidy conditions was cited as a violation and grounds for audits and corrective measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timely implement Rospatent orders to eliminate detected violations
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizations must follow orders issued by Rospatent to eliminate detected violations and provide evidence of fulfillment within required deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to comply resulted in administrative offence reports and fines under Articles 19.5 and 19.7 of the Administrative Offence Code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain Unified registry entries with unique numbers and certificates
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventory objects (R&D results of military, special and dual use) must be entered into the Unified registry, assigned unique registry numbers and issued registration certificates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent maintains the Unified registry per Government decrees; timely entries and certificate issuance are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Government Decrees and adopted checklists/programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow Decrees (e.g., No. 131, No. 218, No. 7) and Rospatent orders adopting forms of checklists (list of control questions) and prevention programs for violations in IP protection and utilization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent has issued formal orders (e.g., No. 212 and No. 213) that set control procedures and programs to be used in federal state control/supervision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure quality and legality of Rospatent decisions and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Rospatent’s decisions on applications and objections must correctly apply law and follow proper procedures in examination and objection handling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Court invalidations occurring due to incorrect application/violation of procedure were low (~2.6%); decisions should consider evidence, guard against fabricated documents, and document lawful bases for actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide registry and research support to federal authorities on means of individualization
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon requests from federal executive authorities, provide information from national registries, explanations, and research to identify resemblance between designations used in civil circulation and protected means of identification/utility models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent must supply methodological and information support, and respond to judicial/federal requests as part of interagency interaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain and prosecute international patent filings and foreign maintenance
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain PCT and foreign patent applications and prosecute/maintain patents abroad as needed for R&D results (e.g., maintain earlier filed PCT applications, obtain foreign patents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FAPRID/Rospatent maintain international filings and manage foreign prosecution; results and counts must be tracked (e.g., number of maintained patents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support and administrate license modification requests per decree procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider and process requests from licensees for additional agreements, amendments, terminations or other license contract changes in accordance with Decree No. 233 and related procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests may be excluded on specified grounds (e.g., obligations performed, court denial); drafts must be prepared and submitted to relevant state customers for approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate in judicial proceedings to defend RF IP interests and claim damages
rubrics_metrics.description: Participate in court hearings to defend the interests of the Russian Federation in enforcing rights to R&D results and pursue claims against licensees for unpaid amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FAPRID’s participation in court and claims amounts are part of enforcement practice; active litigation/claims management is a required enforcement measure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure information access and capacity building via TISC network
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide free access to FIPS databases, enable online filing and digital signature issuance for TISCs, deliver training and monitor TISC performance (ratings and development concepts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TISC support increases practitioners’ ability to file and manage IP; Rospatent monitors TISC efficiency and issues digital signature keys and training per agreements.
